subject: Quiet-room liaison, swarmline & stage cue rota
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Tech AV <av-team@averytech.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@clientco.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quiet-room liaison, swarmline & stage cue rota

Morning team —

Drafting a quick logistic plan for next week's webinar (June 10) focused on minimizing hallway noise and smoothing speaker transitions between greenroom and stage. Key asks below:

- Quiet-room liaison: assign a single point who escorts each guest from greenroom to stage and handles last-minute mic/prop handoffs.
- Swarmline (AV handoff) diagram: how do we stage the AV tech so multiple mics/clickers aren't crossing paths? AV partner, can you confirm feasible staging radius?
- Stage cue rota: short cue sheet (2 steps max) per speaker so hosts can prompt without lengthy stage directions.

Proposed owners: Lauren for liaison rota, Soojin for the cue sheet, Avery Tech for the swarmline. Devon, looping you so CS can plan VIP escort.

Attachments: quiet-room-roster.xlsx (draft) and av-swarmline-diagram.png (sketch).

Goal: final signoff by EOD Thursday 6/3 so ops can print pocket cue cards for greeter staff.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Tech AV <av-team@averytech.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@clientco.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quiet-room liaison, swarmline & stage cue rota

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. Quick notes: 

1) Liaison rota: I've started assigning greeter shifts in the attached roster; proposed approach is 15-minute arrival windows per speaker and a single greeter per window. That keeps the greenroom quiet and reduces overlap.

2) AV staging: Avery, the diagram shows 2m buffer between AV cart and the aisle. Is that workable if we keep one spare lav and one handheld on the side table?

3) Cue sheet: Soojin — can you standardize the prompt to two lines: (a) "Name + 1-liner intro", (b) "Demo handoff: who takes clicker/transition"? We'll use the same template for all speakers to avoid host improvisation.

Attached: quiet-room-roster.xlsx (v2) — column for "VIP escort?" and "mobility needs" added per Jordan's note.

If this looks good I'll lock the roster by Thursday EOD.

- Lauren
Senior Events Producer
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Tech AV <av-team@averytech.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quiet-room liaison, swarmline & stage cue rota

Looping in the short cue sheet and the host intro carousel idea. See below — I'm attaching intro-carousel.docx with 90-second host scripts and a 20-word spotlight blurb for each guest. Also a quick staged cue example for the host: 

Host cue example (two lines):
- "Please welcome Emma Zhou, Head of ML at Acme — Emma, quick 60-second update on your integration."
- "Emma, hand off to demo: Devon, please join with the clicker and two-sentence context."

Swarmline note for AV (from the diagram): please keep the spare lav in the right-side case; if we route the wheeled cart to the stage left wing the greeter can hand the lav through the side door and avoid crossing the main aisle.

Attachments: intro-carousel.docx (90s scripts).

I'll also prepare printed pocket cue cards (2 per host) once the roster is final.

- Soojin
Producer, Field Events
Redwood Inference

Thanks — this looks great and I appreciate the attention to a calm greenroom. A couple of quick items from the guest side: 

- Arrival: I can be there for the 10:00–10:15 window. Please put me down for the 10:00 slot and a single greeter to meet me at the West lobby entrance.
- Mobility/access: I use a folding cane; would appreciate a heads-up if any stairs are on the escort path.
- Intro blurb correction: please list my title as "Head of ML, Acme" (no articles).

I'm copying Devon (our CS contact) who will bring a laptop for the demo; he confirms he can hand off the clicker.

See you all next week,
Emma
Head of ML, Acme
